bigin-harness-setup.summary: Scaffolds an AI workflow harness — CLAUDE.md brief, path-scoped rules, commit gates, optional Cursor mirror. Profiles: nuxt, go, nodejs, next, generic.

task-workflow.summary: On-demand task workflow (/task-workflow): scope → spec → plan (approved) → implement/verify loop (capped, independent verifier) → review → cleanup.

epic-workflow.summary: Decomposes an initiative into ordered, independently shippable units (/epic-workflow), then dispatches one per session through task-workflow.

nuxt-scaffold.summary: Scaffolds a Nuxt 4 BFF app from scratch via a deterministic Node.js script — npm create nuxt@latest + BFF preset + config/sample code. No GitHub clone.

next-scaffold.summary: Scaffolds a Next.js App Router BFF app from scratch via a deterministic Node.js script — create-next-app + BFF preset + shadcn/ui. No GitHub clone.

go-scaffold.summary: Scaffolds a Go modular-monolith REST API — Gin, contract-first oapi-codegen, GORM + Postgres, JWT access/refresh auth + RBAC, boundaries enforced by a test.

nodejs-scaffold.summary: Scaffolds a Node.js modular-monolith REST API — users/posts, code-first OpenAPI (TypeBox) + Drizzle, JWT+argon2id, outbox/inbox + job queue.

sprint-distill.summary: End-of-sprint distillation: merged PRs + touched knowledge/ concepts → proposal-first knowledge/ and bigin-skills updates. Compresses, never just appends.

knowledge-distill.summary: Distills a library's docs/source at a pinned version into audited knowledge/libraries/<lib>/ concept files, plus a version-drift commit guard.

write-tests.summary: On-demand test authoring (/write-tests): style-matches the nearest test file, lists edge cases first, TDD-orders logic, mocks only true I/O boundaries.

debug-workflow.summary: On-demand systematic debugging (/debug-workflow): triage → fast path for obvious bugs, full guarded workflow for flaky/env/repeat-failure bugs.

model-router.summary: Scores capability and verification needs separately, then routes to the quick/standard/deep tier on a per-project model + effort ladder.

session-handoff.summary: Saves session state (tasks, decisions, uncommitted changes) to SESSION.md and restores it on resume.

nuxt-ui-figma-handoff.summary: Turns a Nuxt UI Figma design handoff into code — theme tokens into main.css, component overrides into app.config.ts. Requires a Figma URL.

quick-executor.summary: Mechanical, single-file, low-risk tasks — the quick tier.

standard-worker.summary: Default tier: most feature and bug-fix work.

standard-worker-high.summary: Same role as `standard-worker`, pinned higher; spawned instead of it on those ladders.

deep-architect.summary: Architectural decisions, breaking contract changes, row-transforming migrations, full-spec tier.

verifier.summary: Read-only — audits a diff against `PLAN.md`, not the implementer's summary. Fresh each round.

verifier-medium.summary: Same role as `verifier`, pinned lower; spawned instead of it on that ladder.

knowledge-auditor.summary: Read-only — audits a distilled bundle against the library's cloned source at the pinned commit. Fresh each round.
